mapper.select: SELECT id, parse_uuid, user_id, input_type, input_hash, btih, btmh, trackers_json, input_storage_key, resource_id, status, revision, retry_count, next_retry_at, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM magnet_v2_parse_job WHERE parse_uuid = #{parseUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, parse_uuid, user_id, input_type, input_hash, btih, btmh, trackers_json, input_storage_key, resource_id, status, revision, retry_count, next_retry_at, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM magnet_v2_parse_job WHERE parse_uuid = #{parseUuid} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, parse_uuid, user_id, input_type, input_hash, btih, btmh, trackers_json, input_storage_key, resource_id, status, revision, retry_count, next_retry_at, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM magnet_v2_parse_job WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, parse_uuid, user_id, input_type, input_hash, btih, btmh, trackers_json, input_storage_key, resource_id, status, revision, retry_count, next_retry_at, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM magnet_v2_parse_job WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE magnet_v2_parse_job SET status = 'RESOLVING', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE magnet_v2_parse_job SET status = 'READY', resource_id = #{resourceId}, revision = revision + 1, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND deleted = 0
